utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we pick a book for next week, or are we still deciding?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think we’re still deciding, but I heard a couple of people mention a mystery novel for next week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A mystery could work. Do you know which one they’re leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with the book club if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d be great. I’m a bit all over the place, but I’d love the help with the book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all — I can help you sort out the details and keep it simple. Just tell me what’s left, and we’ll tackle it together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s been lively lately—lots of opinions and a few surprises. I can tell you what’s been going around if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like that, but only if it’s the practical version—who’s coming, where it is, and whether I need to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — it’s at Marcy’s place next Tuesday, and everyone’s bringing a snack or a drink to share. No need for anything fancy, just your book and whatever you’d like to sip on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m thinking we could meet at the library on Maple Street next Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great — the library on Maple Street next Thursday evening works for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club sounds lovely — I can ask around and see who wants to join!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind, Quinn. Thank you — I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and see who’s interested!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Leo — I can help get the book club organized. What book are we thinking about first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be a big help. Let’s start with a short novel everyone can finish easily.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll make a quick list of a few short novels and we can pick one everyone will enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the details first—when and where is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, right — I’m usually the one joining a bit late. I think it’s Thursday evening at the community center, but I should double-check the exact room.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please double-check the room, and let me know when you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check my school pickup schedule and see what evening works best for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be so helpful, thank you. Whatever evening works best for you, I’ll make it fit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let me look at this week’s pickup times, and I’ll text you the best evening for me. I’m hoping we can pick something that keeps it easy for both of us.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club so far—what’s it like?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s pretty relaxed—mostly good conversation, snacks, and a mix of people from different friend groups. You should come sometime; I think you’d fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really nice—I’d be happy to come sometime.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time you’re thinking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Maybe 7? I’m pretty sure that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what book the club is reading next.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think we’re picking one soon — I keep forgetting the title. I’ll ask at the next meeting and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I’d appreciate that. I’m curious what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plans to the others and see who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supplies and bring what we need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll do that and circle back once I’ve heard from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, how’s the book club going lately?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s been going alright—small group, but I’m learning a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—what book are you all reading right now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still trying to remember the title we picked. Was it the mystery one, or the one with the blue cover?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m pretty sure it was the mystery one, but I’d want to double-check before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right — I’d rather double-check too than mix it up again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. I might’ve missed the latest update; what are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading the next chapter and talking about the main character’s choices. Want me to send you the update?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please send it over—I’m a bit behind and don’t want to miss the discussion.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got a few handy tools or supplies I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll let you know what the book club needs and we can make a simple plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just give me a shout when you know what’s needed, and I’ll help keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds great—what book are we thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got a few good picks in mind—want me to send a quick vote with the options?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please send the vote—I’d love to help choose.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help connect everyone for book club—what book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the one we’re reading at the library this month—I’ll bring the title over so we can keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, bring it by and I’ll make sure everyone gets the details. Happy to help keep the book club all in sync.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely—shall I put the book club on the community board and help gather a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please—that would be wonderful. I’ll check the supplies and bring any extra sign-up sheets.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ll add it to the board and let folks know to stop by. Just tell me if you need anything else for the table.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just heard a little second-hand buzz about the book club. What are people saying about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly that it’s small but friendly, and people actually finish the books. Do you want the honest version or just the highlight reel?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Honestly, the honest version, please — I’m new enough to want the real scoop. Is it actually easy to join?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re reading "The Secret Garden" this month, and the kids are pretty excited about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds like a good one. What day are you all meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what’s up with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—are we still meeting Thursday at 7?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, Thursday at 7 still works for me.
